title: Semantic version pattern
prompt:
Write one JavaScript regular expression and nothing else for a three-part numeric version such as 2.4.1.

Accept 0.1.0, 2.4.1, and 10.20.30. Reject 1.2, v1.2.3, 1.2.3.4, and 1.2.3-beta. Use anchors so extra characters fail. Do not call eval. Keep the answer under 40 words.
constraints: Accepts three numeric parts and rejects other shapes
Under 40 words and does not call eval
